What is Uterus Prolapse?
Uterus prolapse happens when the pelvic floor muscles become weak and the uterus descends into the vaginal canal. It can happen due to:

• Normal delivery or multiple pregnancies
• Heavy lifting
• Weak pelvic muscles

Common symptoms include:
• Feeling of heaviness or dragging sensation
• Lower back discomfort
• Difficulty with bowel movements
• Pelvic pressure while standing
